paths.name: @tauri-apps/api/event
paths.message: A plain listen() receives events that Rust targeted at one window (Tauri 2 matches an `Any` listener against every emit_to). Use listenWindow() / onceWindow() from src/platform/tauri/listenWindow.ts, or pass { target: label } explicitly. (K-WINDOW-EVENT)

paths.name: @tauri-apps/plugin-opener
paths.message: Open external links through openExternal() in src/platform/tauri/openExternal.ts so the URL scheme is validated once and every surface behaves the same. (K-EXTERNAL-LINK)

paths.name: node:fs
paths.message: State files written in place are truncated to zero bytes by a crash mid-write. Use writeFileAtomic() / readStateFile() from host/storage/atomic-write.ts for anything the Host reads back at startup. Streaming logs and scratch files may use fs/promises writeFile with an `// oxlint-disable-next-line no-restricted-imports -- <why>` comment. (K-ATOMIC)

no-restricted-properties.message: Run time limits and schedule gaps must not count time the machine spent asleep; Date.now() jumps across sleep and clock changes. Use monotonicNow()/elapsedSince() from src/shared/lib/time/timestamps.ts (or the Host clock port) for durations; Date.now() stays for persisted timestamps only, with an `// oxlint-disable-next-line no-restricted-properties -- timestamp` comment. (K-CLOCK)
